title: Day 22/28 - Azure Sql Database Server Terraform Mini Project
description:
Azure Sql Database Server Terraform Mini Project

Welcome to 22/28 day of the Terraform Full Course for Beginners, in which we'll explore how to provision and manage Azure SQL Database resources using Terraform. Perfect for beginners looking to understand database infrastructure as code!

⚡️ What We'll Cover:
Learn how to create a complete Azure SQL environment from scratch, including server setup, database configuration, and secure access management—all using Terraform.

🔧 Technical Journey:
Setting up Azure SQL Server (MySQL)
Creating your first database
Configuring firewall rules for secure access
Establishing connectivity using SQL clients
